young.oewn-01654162-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

young.oewn-01654162-s.tone: Warm and direct, counting no years at all but the vigour and freshness that read as youth, and asserting it flatly where *youngish* hedges.

youthful.oewn-01654162-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

youthful.oewn-01654162-s.tone: Puts youth forward as a resemblance rather than a fact, so the freshness carries the whole of the claim.

vernal.oewn-01654162-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

vernal.oewn-01654162-s.tone: Literary and elevated where *young* and *youthful* are plain, admiring the vigour rather than merely reporting it.

little.oewn-01653473-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

little.oewn-01653473-s.tone: Warmth sits in the diminutive: the child or young animal is made endearing, where *small* only measures.

small.oewn-01653473-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

small.oewn-01653473-s.tone: Plain and unsentimental about the same young creature as *little*, sized rather than cherished.

early.oewn-01653059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

early.oewn-01653059-s.tone: Neutral and intensifying, pushing youth to its very beginning and saying how far along rather than how it looks.

tender.oewn-01654003-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

tender.oewn-01654003-s.tone: Youth felt as softness, the immaturity something breakable rather than something admired.

junior.oewn-01653333-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

junior.oewn-01653333-s.tone: Purely classificatory, sorting by who is taken in or aimed at, with none of the approval in *youthful*.

boyish.oewn-01652755-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

boyish.oewn-01652755-s.tone: Mildly fond, measuring against a young boy whether the thing suits one or simply resembles one.

youngish.oewn-01654093-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

youngish.oewn-01654093-s.tone: Hedged and faintly grudging, granting youth only approximately where *young* grants it outright.

lady.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: offhand courtesy → stately dignity

lady.oewn-10008828-n.tone: The plain word for it — the refinement is granted without ceremony, where *gentlewoman* makes an occasion of it.

maam.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: offhand courtesy → stately dignity

maam.oewn-10008828-n.tone: Deferential — respect offered to her rather than refinement described about her, and warmer than the starched *madam*.

madam.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: offhand courtesy → stately dignity

madam.oewn-10008828-n.tone: Formal and ceremonious, the courtesy held at a polite distance where *ma'am* closes it.

dame.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: offhand courtesy → stately dignity

dame.oewn-10008828-n.tone: Stately and formal - it names her refinement as a standing she holds and is addressed by, where *ma'am* and *madam* pay the courtesy in passing.

gentlewoman.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: offhand courtesy → stately dignity

gentlewoman.oewn-10008828-n.tone: The stateliest of the set — it treats refinement as her whole standing rather than a courtesy paid in passing.

kindness.oewn-04836995-n.label: positive

family.axis: kindness arrived at by leniency → felt fellow-feeling that moves to act

kindness.oewn-04836995-n.tone: The plainest word for the disposition, warm and unceremonious where *mercy* makes the same forgivingness sound grave.

kindness.oewn-04847242-n.label: positive

family.axis: considerate regard for others → an active willingness to give

kindness.oewn-04847242-n.tone: The broadest praise here, gathering warmth, humanity and fellow-feeling into one standing quality rather than pinning approval to anything done, as *generosity* does.

kindness.oewn-00035041-n.label: positive

family.axis: a considerate gesture → an act of open-hearted good will

kindness.oewn-00035041-n.tone: The plain warm name for the deed itself, with none of the ceremony *benignity* puts around the same act.

pity.oewn-04836781-n.label: positive

family.axis: kindness arrived at by leniency → felt fellow-feeling that moves to act

pity.oewn-04836781-n.tone: Praise here, since the gloss makes it a humane quality, but the word tilts down toward the sufferer where *compassion* stands level.

pity.oewn-07319716-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

pity.oewn-07319716-n.tone: The lightest way here to mark a thing having gone wrong — regret at the turn events took, with no weight of loss behind it.

compassion.oewn-04836781-n.label: positive

family.axis: kindness arrived at by leniency → felt fellow-feeling that moves to act

compassion.oewn-04836781-n.tone: The warmest word in the set: understanding that already carries the will to do something, not merely to be moved.

mercy.oewn-04836513-n.label: positive

family.axis: kindness arrived at by leniency → felt fellow-feeling that moves to act

mercy.oewn-04836513-n.tone: Grave and elevated where *kindness* is homely, giving the same forgiving disposition the weight of a virtue.

mildness.oewn-04837153-n.label: positive

family.axis: kindness arrived at by leniency → felt fellow-feeling that moves to act

mildness.oewn-04837153-n.tone: Faintest approval here, since the mercifulness follows from being lenient or tolerant rather than from any felt impulse, so it can shade toward slackness.

shame.oewn-14463603-n.label: negative

family.axis: dishonor named plainly → dishonor at its most abject

shame.oewn-14463603-n.tone: The plain name for the condition of being dishonored, weighted no heavier than the fall itself.

shame.oewn-07319716-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

shame.oewn-07319716-n.tone: Meets the same unfortunate turn as *pity* with a sharper note of protest, as though the outcome were one that need not have happened.

reproach.oewn-14465180-n.label: negative

family.axis: dishonor named plainly → dishonor at its most abject

reproach.oewn-14465180-n.tone: Names the disgrace or the shame as something laid at a person's door, so blame is audible in it where *shame* only records the state.

disgrace.oewn-14463603-n.label: negative

family.axis: dishonor named plainly → dishonor at its most abject

disgrace.oewn-14463603-n.tone: Puts the weight on standing forfeited rather than on anything felt, a blunter word than *shame* for the same condition.

ignominy.oewn-14463603-n.label: negative

family.axis: dishonor named plainly → dishonor at its most abject

ignominy.oewn-14463603-n.tone: Formal and absolute, pitching the dishonor so low that *disgrace* sounds like an understatement.

humiliation.oewn-14463954-n.label: negative

family.axis: dishonor named plainly → dishonor at its most abject

humiliation.oewn-14463954-n.tone: Reaches both ways at once, the outward disgrace and the inward loss of self-respect, so it degrades the person and not only the position.

virtue.oewn-04854529-n.label: positive

family.axis: kind and gentle temper → moral rightness held whole

virtue.oewn-04854529-n.tone: Praises goodness as conduct measured against a standard — the right done and the wrong refused, both halves — where *goodness* names a quality simply possessed.

virtue.oewn-04856990-n.label: positive

family.axis: sexual morality named as conduct → sexual morality named as a woman's standing

virtue.oewn-04856990-n.tone: Approving but plain, naming sexual conduct as a moral good in itself without *honour*'s sense of a reputation that can be taken away.

virtue.oewn-05146223-n.label: positive

family.axis: a shortfall counted against a thing → a high quality counted admiringly in its favour

virtue.oewn-05146223-n.tone: Presents an attribute as admirable in itself, already judged and approved, where *value* only weighs.

beneficence.oewn-04847768-n.label: positive

family.axis: kind and gentle temper → moral rightness held whole

beneficence.oewn-04847768-n.tone: Formal and elevated, and the broadest of these — kindness, helpfulness and generosity at once, active where *benignity* is only mild.

benignity.oewn-04848212-n.label: positive

family.axis: kind and gentle temper → moral rightness held whole

benignity.oewn-04848212-n.tone: Formal, and the gentlest praise here: a mild kindly temper rather than the good actually done that *beneficence* credits.

benignity.oewn-00035041-n.label: positive

family.axis: a considerate gesture → an act of open-hearted good will

benignity.oewn-00035041-n.tone: Formal and elevated, praising a kind act at a slight remove where *kindness* simply names it.

graciousness.oewn-04848212-n.label: positive

family.axis: kind and gentle temper → moral rightness held whole

graciousness.oewn-04848212-n.tone: The same kindness and gentleness as *benignity*, but with a warmth of manner that makes it feel offered rather than merely held.

graciousness.oewn-04920745-n.label: positive

family.axis: politeness kept to its outward form → manners raised to excellence

graciousness.oewn-04920745-n.tone: Not merely meeting the standard of manners but excelling at it, which puts it at the top of this family where *civility* sits at the bottom.

style.oewn-04820120-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

style.oewn-04820120-n.tone: Approving and self-assured: elegance with a signature on it, where *elegance* alone can be impersonal.

elegance.oewn-04819517-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

elegance.oewn-04819517-n.tone: The plain central name for the quality — gracefulness and good taste, with no dazzle asked of it.

dash.oewn-04820120-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

dash.oewn-04820120-n.tone: The same stylish elegance with spirit in it, brisk and showy where *style* is merely distinctive.

dash.oewn-00557020-n.label: neutral

family.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

dash.oewn-00557020-n.tone: Speed as a short spirited burst, brisk and deliberate beside the startled suddenness of *bolt*.

delicacy.oewn-04820315-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

delicacy.oewn-04820315-n.tone: Praises beauty that is fine rather than bold, the softest note in a family that runs to *grandeur*.

grandeur.oewn-04821469-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

grandeur.oewn-04821469-n.tone: Elevated and imposing — splendour on a scale that asks to be looked up at.

class.oewn-04822408-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

class.oewn-04822408-n.tone: Informal and flatly approving: elegance of dress or behaviour named in one blunt syllable.

breeding.oewn-04820771-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

breeding.oewn-04820771-n.tone: Places the elegance in fineness of manner and expression, praising a person's polish rather than any effect they make.

splendor.oewn-04821469-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

splendor.oewn-04821469-n.tone: Full-throated praise for the magnificent, glowing where *grandeur* towers.

pomp.oewn-04822233-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

pomp.oewn-04822233-n.tone: Binds the splendour to ceremony, so the praise falls on the staging rather than on the thing staged.

daintiness.oewn-04820315-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

daintiness.oewn-04820315-n.tone: The homelier name for beauty in fineness, prettier and less lofty in sound than *delicacy*.

smartness.oewn-04820943-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

smartness.oewn-04820943-n.tone: Measures the elegance by fashion, approving of being current in a way *elegance* never is.

magnificence.oewn-04821469-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

magnificence.oewn-04821469-n.tone: The largest word here — grandeur and splendour taken together at full strength, with nothing held back.

brilliance.oewn-04821469-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

brilliance.oewn-04821469-n.tone: Magnificence that dazzles, adding glitter where *grandeur* adds height.

splendour.oewn-04821469-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

splendour.oewn-04821469-n.tone: The British spelling of *splendor*, identical to it in force.

eclat.oewn-04822233-n.label: positive

family.axis: quiet refinement → dazzling magnificence

eclat.oewn-04822233-n.tone: Ceremonial splendour with a flourish on it — the dazzle the occasion throws off, where *pomp* is the display itself.

love.oewn-09869006-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

love.oewn-09869006-n.tone: The simplest of these endearments, naming the feeling outright with nothing decorative added to it.

dear.oewn-09869006-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

dear.oewn-09869006-n.tone: Gentle and well-mannered where *love* is bare — affection kept quiet rather than declared.

dear.oewn-10263569-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain fact of inexperience → fond naming of a gentle, harmless soul

dear.oewn-10263569-n.tone: Fond and protective, making sweetness and mildness the whole of the person; beside *lamb* it carries no picture, only affection.

baby.oewn-09869006-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

baby.oewn-09869006-n.tone: Tender in a way that casts the beloved as small and to be cosseted, which *sweetheart* does not do.

dearest.oewn-09869006-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

dearest.oewn-09869006-n.tone: The superlative does the work — it does not merely call the person dear but sets them above everyone else.

honey.oewn-09869006-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

honey.oewn-09869006-n.tone: Homely and sweet-tasting warmth, comfortable where *dearest* is fervent.

darling.oewn-09869006-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

darling.oewn-09869006-n.tone: Doting and unembarrassed, the most lavish of these terms of endearment.

sweetheart.oewn-09869006-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

sweetheart.oewn-09869006-n.tone: Names the beloved by the heart itself, wholesome and unironic in a way *baby* is not.

girl.oewn-10150206-n.label: neutral

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

girl.oewn-10150206-n.tone: Flat beside the endearments: it identifies her wholly by a man's romantic involvement rather than expressing any feeling toward her.

girl.oewn-10104064-n.label: neutral

family.axis: bare classification by sex → a person defined by her tie to a particular man

girl.oewn-10104064-n.tone: Marks youth and nothing else, saying nothing about who she is to anyone, unlike *woman* here.

fellow.oewn-09890770-n.label: neutral

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

fellow.oewn-09890770-n.tone: A bare designation of the man in the relation, carrying none of the warmth that *darling* pours out.

fellow.oewn-10103295-n.label: positive

family.axis: membership not yet complete → belonging claimed as kinship or honour

fellow.oewn-10103295-n.tone: Membership as conferred standing — a learned society's name for one of its own, where *member* would only note that someone belongs.

lover.oewn-09645472-n.label: neutral

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

lover.oewn-09645472-n.tone: Works from either side of the bond — the one who loves or the one who is loved — and states the relation rather than performing it.

favourite.oewn-10011405-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

favourite.oewn-10011405-n.tone: Warmth arrived at by comparison: this one is loved specially, which implies others ranked below.

admirer.oewn-09790858-n.label: neutral

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

admirer.oewn-09790858-n.tone: Puts the feeling entirely on one side — his admiring of her — with nothing in the word saying it is returned.

squeeze.oewn-10663023-n.label: neutral

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

squeeze.oewn-10663023-n.tone: Slang, and breezily physical: it holds a girlfriend or boyfriend at a jaunty distance from the tenderness of *sweetheart*.

pet.oewn-10011405-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain naming of the beloved → open, doting endearment

pet.oewn-10011405-n.tone: Fondness with a stroking, indulgent hand in it, where *favourite* under the same sense is merely preference.

temper.oewn-04649615-n.label: negative

family.axis: annoyance at being kept waiting → a standing readiness for uncontrolled anger

temper.oewn-04649615-n.tone: The heaviest charge in the family: not a passing mood but a settled liability to anger that gets out of hand, so attributing it is an accusation about character.

impatience.oewn-04649953-n.label: negative

family.axis: annoyance at being kept waiting → a standing readiness for uncontrolled anger

impatience.oewn-04649953-n.tone: The narrowest fault here - it fastens on one trigger, delay, and so criticises without alleging the loss of control that *temper* does.

impatience.oewn-14430687-n.label: negative

family.axis: ordinary annoyance → a visible flare of pique

impatience.oewn-14430687-n.tone: Names the state by what it lacks, and pins the irritation to one cause — anything that makes you wait.

asperity.oewn-04650456-n.label: negative

family.axis: annoyance at being kept waiting → a standing readiness for uncontrolled anger

asperity.oewn-04650456-n.tone: Formal, and it locates the fault in bearing and manner rather than in feeling, which makes the condemnation cool and considered.

sharpness.oewn-04650456-n.label: negative

family.axis: annoyance at being kept waiting → a standing readiness for uncontrolled anger

sharpness.oewn-04650456-n.tone: The plain word for the same harsh manner, felt as a cutting edge on how someone deals with you rather than *asperity*'s formal verdict on them.

affair.oewn-13954922-n.label: negative

family.axis: the tie named softly → the tie named with a romantic flourish

affair.oewn-13954922-n.tone: The blunt name for the thing, stating the secrecy or the illicitness plainly where *intimacy* muffles it.

intimacy.oewn-13954922-n.label: neutral

family.axis: the tie named softly → the tie named with a romantic flourish

intimacy.oewn-13954922-n.tone: Names the same secretive or illicit tie by its closeness alone, a soft covering over what *affair* says outright.

amour.oewn-13954922-n.label: positive

family.axis: the tie named softly → the tie named with a romantic flourish

amour.oewn-13954922-n.tone: Lends the secretive or illicit tie a romantic, faintly literary glamour that *affair* denies it.

ignorant.oewn-00834520-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain absence of study → the gap charged as a fault in the person

ignorant.oewn-00834520-s.tone: Blunt and accusing: the missing fundamentals of one art or branch of learning are laid at the person's door rather than at their schooling's, which is what makes it bite where *untutored* does not.

illiterate.oewn-00834520-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain absence of study → the gap charged as a fault in the person

illiterate.oewn-00834520-s.tone: Borrows the whole force of being unable to read and drops it on a single field's fundamentals, so a bounded gap in knowledge sounds total — showier scorn than *ignorant*.

untutored.oewn-00835235-s.label: negative

family.axis: a plain absence of study → the gap charged as a fault in the person

untutored.oewn-00835235-s.tone: Mild and almost exculpating, since it puts the deficiency in the schooling that was never had rather than in the head that went without it.

unstudied.oewn-00835442-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a plain absence of study → the gap charged as a fault in the person

unstudied.oewn-00835442-s.tone: A flat report that knowledge was not gained by study, with or without a particular field in view, and no reproach travels with it — the coolest word here beside *ignorant*.

excuse.oewn-05829462-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

excuse.oewn-05829462-n.tone: Flatly dismissive - the thing is put forward as an example and judged to fall short of being one.

excuse.oewn-06754000-n.label: negative

family.axis: a plea that concedes the fault it covers → a justification that clears the act outright

excuse.oewn-06754000-n.tone: Admits the fault while covering it - what is being defended is already offensive behaviour or a promise broken, whereas *defence* presumes nothing against the act at all.

apology.oewn-05829462-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

apology.oewn-05829462-n.tone: Rueful where *excuse* is blunt - the same verdict of inadequacy, delivered with a wince rather than a sneer.

illustration.oewn-05828980-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

illustration.oewn-05828980-n.tone: Neutral, and the instance is offered to make the class visible - explanatory work that *instance* makes no claim to.

instance.oewn-05828980-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

instance.oewn-05828980-n.tone: The barest of the neutral terms - one case counted off, with none of the demonstrative purpose of *illustration*.

example.oewn-05828980-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

example.oewn-05828980-n.tone: The plain unmarked word for a typical item, carrying neither the explanatory duty of *illustration* nor the scrutiny of *specimen*.

exception.oewn-05829606-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

exception.oewn-05829606-n.tone: Positional rather than evaluative - the instance is defined by not fitting the rule, and the word passes no judgement on it for that.

specimen.oewn-05830599-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

specimen.oewn-05830599-n.tone: Clinical - the instance is held up and inspected as a stand-in for its class, where *example* merely names it.

precedent.oewn-05829846-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

precedent.oewn-05829846-n.tone: Gives the instance forward reach - an example that licenses what comes after it rather than just typifying a group.

hurry.oewn-00556685-n.label: negative

family.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

hurry.oewn-00556685-n.tone: The plainest name for going fast and going badly at once, with the carelessness carried quietly rather than pressed.

hurry.oewn-05067358-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare rate of happening → speed marked as excessive and careless

hurry.oewn-05067358-n.tone: The plain word for speed that has got ahead of itself, and it leaves the carelessness a risk rather than a verdict.

rush.oewn-00556685-n.label: negative

family.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

rush.oewn-00556685-n.tone: Puts the weight on momentum - a harder-edged, more headlong version of *hurry*, where the speed is what overrides the care.

haste.oewn-00556685-n.label: negative

family.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

haste.oewn-00556685-n.tone: Formal and weighty, naming the hurry as a fault to be answered for where *hurry* merely reports it.

haste.oewn-05067358-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare rate of happening → speed marked as excessive and careless

haste.oewn-05067358-n.tone: Graver and more formal than *hurry* - the over-eagerness sounds like a fault being named, with the carelessness pressing right behind it.

rushing.oewn-00556685-n.label: negative

family.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

rushing.oewn-00556685-n.tone: The participle keeps the careless speed running on as an activity rather than a single lapse, unlike the finished act *rush* names.

bolt.oewn-00557020-n.label: neutral

family.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

bolt.oewn-00557020-n.tone: Great speed as a sudden break away, all abruptness and no blame - the carelessness that shadows *hurry* is absent.

scamper.oewn-00557179-n.label: negative

family.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

scamper.oewn-00557179-n.tone: Makes the hurry small and skittering, so the loss of dignity comes out as comic rather than damning.

scramble.oewn-00557179-n.label: negative

family.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

scramble.oewn-00557179-n.tone: The undignified hurry as graceless floundering - effortful disorder where *scamper* is merely quick and silly.

speed.oewn-05065291-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare rate of happening → speed marked as excessive and careless

speed.oewn-05065291-n.tone: The bare measure of how fast something happens, with none of the reproach that *haste* attaches to the same quickness.

swiftness.oewn-05065291-n.label: positive

family.axis: a bare rate of happening → speed marked as excessive and careless

swiftness.oewn-05065291-n.tone: Names that same rate as a quality something possesses, so it carries a lift of admiration where *speed* stays a flat reading.

mother.oewn-10352666-n.label: positive

family.axis: respectful address for an old woman → old woman rendered ugly and evil

mother.oewn-10352666-n.tone: A way of speaking to an old woman rather than a way of describing her, and it lends her the standing of kin in the act of addressing her.

witch.oewn-10175045-n.label: negative

family.axis: respectful address for an old woman → old woman rendered ugly and evil

witch.oewn-10175045-n.tone: Puts menace behind the ugliness - she does not just look evil, she looks capable of it, which is the charge *hag* leaves off.

hag.oewn-10175045-n.label: negative

family.axis: respectful address for an old woman → old woman rendered ugly and evil

hag.oewn-10175045-n.tone: Repulsion with nothing added: the same ugly, evil-looking figure as *witch* but stripped of any power, so it jeers where *witch* recoils.

granny.oewn-10163050-n.label: negative

family.axis: respectful address for an old woman → old woman rendered ugly and evil

granny.oewn-10163050-n.tone: A diminutive fastened to any old woman at all, grandmother or not - familiar where *mother* is deferential, and it shrinks her to her age.

civility.oewn-04921310-n.label: neutral

family.axis: politeness kept to its outward form → manners raised to excellence

civility.oewn-04921310-n.tone: The family's floor: politeness as observed form, either done correctly or gone through with no interest at all, which is why it approves far less warmly than *graciousness*.

respect.oewn-04921016-n.label: positive

family.axis: politeness kept to its outward form → manners raised to excellence

respect.oewn-04921016-n.tone: Aims the courtesy at what another person feels rather than at a code of conduct, so it credits attention where *politeness* credits only correctness.

gallantry.oewn-04920915-n.label: positive

family.axis: politeness kept to its outward form → manners raised to excellence

gallantry.oewn-04920915-n.tone: Defined by whom the courtesy is shown to — women — so it marks its object where *courtesy* marks only the manner.

courtesy.oewn-04919909-n.label: positive

family.axis: politeness kept to its outward form → manners raised to excellence

courtesy.oewn-04919909-n.tone: The unmarked term for the manner itself, with no standard, object or degree attached; every word beside it adds one of those.

deference.oewn-04921016-n.label: positive

family.axis: politeness kept to its outward form → manners raised to excellence

deference.oewn-04921016-n.tone: The same courteous regard for feelings as *respect*, but with a yielding in it — the regard shows itself by giving way.

niceness.oewn-04920159-n.label: positive

family.axis: politeness kept to its outward form → manners raised to excellence

niceness.oewn-04920159-n.tone: The plainest name for conduct that respects accepted usage, so mild that the approval barely registers as praise beside *politeness*.

deceive.oewn-00856102-v.label: negative

family.axis: swelling something past its true size → planting an outright falsehood in a believer

deceive.oewn-00856102-v.tone: Names the act by its result — the untruth has landed and is believed — where *mislead* stops at the information handed over.

deceive.oewn-02581157-v.label: negative

family.axis: being false with someone → being false and taking something by it

deceive.oewn-02581157-v.tone: The plain, flat accusation of bad faith — it names the dishonesty and stops there, without saying what anyone got out of it.

betray.oewn-00856102-v.label: negative

family.axis: swelling something past its true size → planting an outright falsehood in a believer

betray.oewn-00856102-v.tone: The same planting of a false belief, but the word frames it as a breach of the trust that made the believing possible, which is what makes it the heaviest term here.

betray.oewn-00938362-v.label: negative

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

betray.oewn-00938362-v.tone: The teller never meant to tell: the thing escapes and gives the person away, so the fault is in the letting slip rather than the intent.

betray.oewn-01803246-v.label: negative

family.axis: hopes left unmet → trust broken and the person deserted

betray.oewn-01803246-v.tone: The same desertion as *fail*, but framed as trust broken against the person left behind, which is why it is the heaviest word here.

lie.oewn-00835938-v.label: negative

family.axis: swelling something past its true size → planting an outright falsehood in a believer

lie.oewn-00835938-v.tone: Flat and unsoftened, covering both the untruth spoken and the pretence behind it, with no room left for an innocent reading.

mislead.oewn-00835688-v.label: negative

family.axis: swelling something past its true size → planting an outright falsehood in a believer

mislead.oewn-00835688-v.tone: The gentlest of the deceptions: it charges only the false or misleading information given and leaves intent unsettled, where *lie* settles it.

magnify.oewn-00841513-v.label: negative

family.axis: swelling something past its true size → planting an outright falsehood in a believer

magnify.oewn-00841513-v.tone: Makes the thing itself loom larger, so the overreach shows in the size of the picture rather than in a claim stated outright.

exaggerate.oewn-00841513-v.label: negative

family.axis: swelling something past its true size → planting an outright falsehood in a believer

exaggerate.oewn-00841513-v.tone: The plain charge of overstatement, taking in both going past reasonable bounds and going past the truth, and always implying the real measure is smaller.

amplify.oewn-00841513-v.label: neutral

family.axis: swelling something past its true size → planting an outright falsehood in a believer

amplify.oewn-00841513-v.tone: Says only that something has been swelled; the fault lies in the going beyond, not in the verb, which is why it accuses least of the three.

delude.oewn-02581157-v.label: negative

family.axis: being false with someone → being false and taking something by it

delude.oewn-02581157-v.tone: Heavier than *deceive* because the falseness is aimed at the other person's mind, leaving them settled in something untrue.

cheat.oewn-02579332-v.label: negative

family.axis: being false with someone → being false and taking something by it

cheat.oewn-02579332-v.tone: The hardest word here: the lie has a victim who is out something, and the loss is built into the charge.

chisel.oewn-02579332-v.label: negative

family.axis: being false with someone → being false and taking something by it

chisel.oewn-02579332-v.tone: Informal, and the pettiness is the sting — the same deceitful taking as *cheat*, cut down to something small and mean.

capable.oewn-00512273-s.label: positive

family.axis: sufficient for the job → genuinely skilled at it

capable.oewn-00512273-s.tone: The same compliment pitched cooler than *able* — an appraisal of what someone is equipped to do well rather than a warm word for them.

competent.oewn-00511975-a.label: positive

family.axis: sufficient for the job → genuinely skilled at it

competent.oewn-00511975-a.tone: The mildest approval here, since 'properly or sufficiently' sets a threshold and reports it met — qualified, capable or efficient enough, and no claim beyond enough.

efficient.oewn-00512569-s.label: positive

family.axis: sufficient for the job → genuinely skilled at it

efficient.oewn-00512569-s.tone: Approval aimed at the working rather than the worker: the purpose is accomplished and the thing functions, which is a narrower compliment than *able*.

workmanlike.oewn-00512962-s.label: positive

family.axis: sufficient for the job → genuinely skilled at it

workmanlike.oewn-00512962-s.tone: Praises by holding the thing up to a standard-bearer — worthy of a good workman — which makes it concrete where *competent* stays abstract.

constant.oewn-00585590-a.label: positive

family.axis: unchanging as a bare fact → steadiness that never tires

constant.oewn-00585590-a.tone: Straightforward praise for not wavering, and it covers purpose, devotion and affection alike rather than loyalty alone.

steadfast.oewn-00586061-s.label: positive

family.axis: unchanging as a bare fact → steadiness that never tires

steadfast.oewn-00586061-s.tone: Weightier than *constant* because it adds dependability, making the firmness something others can lean on.

steadfast.oewn-01997735-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

steadfast.oewn-01997735-s.tone: The warmest of the unshakable four - firmness praised as something held faithfully over time.

immutable.oewn-00585950-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unchanging as a bare fact → steadiness that never tires

immutable.oewn-00585950-s.tone: Absolute and cool: it reports that a thing does not change rather than crediting it with holding fast, so no praise attaches the way it does to *steadfast*.

unfailing.oewn-00586322-s.label: positive

family.axis: unchanging as a bare fact → steadiness that never tires

unfailing.oewn-00586322-s.tone: Approving of what never runs out, measuring steadiness by supply rather than by the refusal to vary that *constant* asks for.

unflagging.oewn-00586322-s.label: positive

family.axis: unchanging as a bare fact → steadiness that never tires

unflagging.oewn-00586322-s.tone: The same tirelessness as *unfailing*, but figured as a pace that never slackens rather than a store that never empties.

disaster.oewn-07329438-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

disaster.oewn-07329438-n.tone: Lifts the scale abruptly out of bad luck into great loss, and does it more bluntly than *catastrophe*.

catastrophe.oewn-07329438-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

catastrophe.oewn-07329438-n.tone: The same great loss as *disaster*, pitched as total and past reversing, with nothing left to salvage.

tragedy.oewn-07329438-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

tragedy.oewn-07329438-n.tone: Loads the great loss with grief and waste, asking that it be mourned rather than merely counted up.

mishap.oewn-07329027-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

mishap.oewn-07329027-n.tone: Shrinks misfortune to one small instance, a thing to be shrugged off rather than suffered.

calamity.oewn-07329438-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

calamity.oewn-07329438-n.tone: Ruin on the scale of *disaster* but declared in a grander, more sonorous register.

hardship.oewn-07351363-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

hardship.oewn-07351363-n.tone: Covers both what inflicts the suffering and the suffering entailed, a weight borne over time where *mishap* is over in a moment.

knock.oewn-07351599-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

knock.oewn-07351599-n.tone: Blunt and physical, casting a bad experience as a single blow taken and absorbed.

mischance.oewn-07329027-n.label: negative

family.axis: a passing piece of bad luck → an event of ruinous loss

mischance.oewn-07329027-n.tone: The more formal twin of *mishap*, putting the weight on the luck of the thing rather than the damage done.

honour.oewn-04857203-n.label: positive

family.axis: sexual morality named as conduct → sexual morality named as a woman's standing

honour.oewn-04857203-n.tone: Raises a woman's chastity to a matter of standing — something she is credited with and can be stripped of — where *virtue* only calls it moral; British spelling of *honor*.

honor.oewn-04857203-n.label: positive

family.axis: sexual morality named as conduct → sexual morality named as a woman's standing

honor.oewn-04857203-n.tone: The same weighted word as *honour* in its American spelling: a woman's chastity treated as her good name rather than as conduct.

buy.oewn-00685589-v.label: neutral

family.axis: reasoned assent → uncritical credulity

buy.oewn-00685589-v.tone: Blunt and informal where *believe* is plain, it treats accepting a claim as taking something on offer, so the acceptance sounds weighed rather than simply held.

buy.oewn-02288941-v.label: negative

family.axis: the person had a price → the payment named as the offence

buy.oewn-02288941-v.tone: The plain word for a purchase turned on a person, so the contempt lies in the implication - they had a price - where *bribe* states the illegality outright.

believe.oewn-00685199-v.label: neutral

family.axis: reasoned assent → uncritical credulity

believe.oewn-00685199-v.tone: The unmarked word for taking something to be true, carrying no judgement on whether the acceptance was earned.

understand.oewn-00594917-v.label: neutral

family.axis: reasoned assent → uncritical credulity

understand.oewn-00594917-v.tone: Softer than *believe*: it presents the belief as settled information one has come by, which lets the speaker hold it lightly.

swallow.oewn-00603054-v.label: negative

family.axis: reasoned assent → uncritical credulity

swallow.oewn-00603054-v.tone: Disparaging of the believer rather than the claim, since the gloss builds the absence of questioning into the acceptance itself.

infer.oewn-00594917-v.label: neutral

family.axis: reasoned assent → uncritical credulity

infer.oewn-00594917-v.tone: Formal, and it frames the belief as arrived at rather than merely held, giving it a footing *believe* does not claim.

bribe.oewn-02288941-v.label: negative

family.axis: the person had a price → the payment named as the offence

bribe.oewn-02288941-v.tone: Names the payment as the offence it is, an accusation rather than the sardonic understatement of *buy*.

father.oewn-10127072-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain originator of an institution → revered progenitor of it

father.oewn-10127072-n.tone: Reverent - it casts the one who established the institution as its progenitor, giving the thing founded a lineage and the founder a claim on gratitude.

beginner.oewn-10127072-n.label: neutral

family.axis: plain originator of an institution → revered progenitor of it

beginner.oewn-10127072-n.tone: Flat and unadorned - it credits the act of starting an institution and stops there, without the honour *father* confers on the same person.

woman.oewn-10808492-n.label: negative

family.axis: bare classification by sex → a person defined by her tie to a particular man

woman.oewn-10808492-n.tone: Fixes a person by her attachment to one man and leaves the exact tie open — wife, mistress or girlfriend all answer to it — which is the possessive edge *female* has none of.

female.oewn-09642198-n.label: neutral

family.axis: bare classification by sex → a person defined by her tie to a particular man

female.oewn-09642198-n.tone: Flat classification by the sex that bears children, carrying neither the age of *girl* nor the relational claim of *woman*.

friend.oewn-10132360-n.label: positive

family.axis: someone who is simply often in your company → someone cherished and confided in

friend.oewn-10132360-n.tone: The plain, unhedged word for the bond, holding affection and trust together where *associate* names only the company kept.

light.oewn-10296356-n.label: positive

family.axis: someone who is simply often in your company → someone cherished and confided in

light.oewn-10296356-n.tone: Pure fondness raised as high as the family goes, prizing the person without saying anything about trust or shared company.

mate.oewn-10319821-n.label: positive

family.axis: someone who is simply often in your company → someone cherished and confided in

mate.oewn-10319821-n.tone: Informal and easy, and it specifies a friend of the same sex where *friend* leaves that unsaid.

crony.oewn-09897417-n.label: positive

family.axis: someone who is simply often in your company → someone cherished and confided in

crony.oewn-09897417-n.tone: Measures closeness in activities shared with a whole set of buddies, so the friendship is company kept rather than confidences given as in *intimate*.

chum.oewn-09897417-n.label: positive

family.axis: someone who is simply often in your company → someone cherished and confided in

chum.oewn-09897417-n.tone: Openly affectionate for the same close, always-along friend, where *crony* leaves the fondness unspoken.

associate.oewn-09965384-n.label: neutral

family.axis: someone who is simply often in your company → someone cherished and confided in

associate.oewn-09965384-n.tone: The coolest of the words for frequent company, recording the habit and withholding any verdict on the affection behind it.

intimate.oewn-09974118-n.label: positive

family.axis: someone who is simply often in your company → someone cherished and confided in

intimate.oewn-09974118-n.tone: Defines the friend entirely by what may be told them, making closeness a matter of trusted secrets rather than time spent together as in *companion*.

character.oewn-14462159-n.label: positive

family.axis: bare standing that could go either way → being held in high esteem and honor

character.oewn-14462159-n.tone: The good is built into the word here, so unlike *name* it needs no adjective to come out favorable.

name.oewn-14462254-n.label: neutral

family.axis: bare standing that could go either way → being held in high esteem and honor

name.oewn-14462254-n.tone: The plainest term for what a person is held to be, carrying no verdict of its own and taking whatever *character* or disgrace is attached to it.

stock.oewn-14462007-n.label: neutral

family.axis: bare standing that could go either way → being held in high esteem and honor

stock.oewn-14462007-n.tone: Treats standing as a quantity that rises and falls, and pairs it with popularity rather than the honor *reputation* names.

reputation.oewn-14461591-n.label: positive

family.axis: bare standing that could go either way → being held in high esteem and honor

reputation.oewn-14461591-n.tone: The full weight of the family: not merely being thought well of but being held in high esteem and honor.

fame.oewn-14462364-n.label: positive

family.axis: bare standing that could go either way → being held in high esteem and honor

fame.oewn-14462364-n.tone: Adds breadth to approval — the favor is public, where *character* keeps good standing a private matter.

repute.oewn-14461591-n.label: positive

family.axis: bare standing that could go either way → being held in high esteem and honor

repute.oewn-14461591-n.tone: The formal counterpart to *reputation*, stating the same high esteem and honor in a more elevated register.

uncle.oewn-10755916-n.label: positive

family.axis: a standing source of help and counsel → a rescuer from actual danger

uncle.oewn-10755916-n.tone: Warm and informal, casting the helper as a standing resource of help, advice and encouragement rather than a one-off saviour like *deliverer*.

patron.oewn-10427699-n.label: positive

family.axis: a standing source of help and counsel → a rescuer from actual danger

patron.oewn-10427699-n.tone: Approving, but aimed at a thing supported or championed rather than at a person in trouble, so the credit is for backing and advocacy rather than for relief.

deliverer.oewn-10573233-n.label: positive

family.axis: a standing source of help and counsel → a rescuer from actual danger

deliverer.oewn-10573233-n.tone: The most elevated of the three and the most urgent, since the help it names is rescue from harm or danger, not the encouragement of *uncle*.

pride.oewn-00759528-n.label: negative

family.axis: self-esteem swollen past reason → that swollen self-esteem turned outward as a superior manner toward those below

pride.oewn-00759528-n.tone: Here the word is a vice and not a virtue - self-esteem grown unreasonable and past all proportion, and grave enough to stand as one of the deadly sins.

arrogance.oewn-04895107-n.label: negative

family.axis: self-esteem swollen past reason → that swollen self-esteem turned outward as a superior manner toward those below

arrogance.oewn-04895107-n.tone: A flat accusation: the swollen self-regard of *pride* has stopped being inward and is now overbearing, worn as a superior manner toward those it counts as inferior.

hauteur.oewn-04895107-n.label: negative

family.axis: self-esteem swollen past reason → that swollen self-esteem turned outward as a superior manner toward those below

hauteur.oewn-04895107-n.tone: Formal and chilly, naming the same overbearing pride as a bearing one carries above inferiors rather than levelling the blunt charge *arrogance* makes.

lamb.oewn-10263569-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain fact of inexperience → fond naming of a gentle, harmless soul

lamb.oewn-10263569-n.tone: Tender in the same way as *dear* but with the creature behind it, so the gentleness comes with defencelessness attached.

innocent.oewn-09644529-n.label: positive

family.axis: plain fact of inexperience → fond naming of a gentle, harmless soul

innocent.oewn-09644529-n.tone: Names the absence itself rather than cooing over the person, so the warmth of *dear* gives way to something closer to unguardedness.

virgin.oewn-10774925-n.label: neutral

family.axis: plain fact of inexperience → fond naming of a gentle, harmless soul

virgin.oewn-10774925-n.tone: States a plain fact about a person's experience and attaches no fondness or reproach to it.

appearance.oewn-00756620-n.label: negative

family.axis: a face kept up to impress → a deliberate, overdone pose

appearance.oewn-00756620-n.tone: The mildest word here for faking it, faulting the wish to look good rather than the falsehood itself, which is where *pretence* puts the blame.

show.oewn-00756620-n.label: negative

family.axis: a face kept up to impress → a deliberate, overdone pose

show.oewn-00756620-n.tone: Treats the same impression-making pretence as something staged for onlookers, with more of a sneer at the performance than *appearance* carries.

affectation.oewn-00757016-n.label: negative

family.axis: a face kept up to impress → a deliberate, overdone pose

affectation.oewn-00757016-n.tone: Convicts the pretence of being both calculated and laid on too thick, so the fault is excess as much as falsity.

pretence.oewn-00756299-n.label: negative

family.axis: a face kept up to impress → a deliberate, overdone pose

pretence.oewn-00756299-n.tone: The flat, general name for putting up a false front, with none of the flattering motive that softens *appearance* and no charge of overdoing it; British spelling.

pretence.oewn-04686265-n.label: negative

family.axis: a surface that merely shades the truth → a covering got up to misrepresent it

pretence.oewn-04686265-n.tone: British spelling, and it foregrounds the artfulness, naming the semblance as something got up rather than something merely appearing.

benevolence.oewn-04847516-n.label: positive

family.axis: considerate regard for others → an active willingness to give

benevolence.oewn-04847516-n.tone: Formal and elevated, praising a settled leaning toward kind or charitable acts rather than the acts themselves, which keeps it cooler than *kindness*.

benevolence.oewn-01229168-n.label: positive

family.axis: a considerate gesture → an act of open-hearted good will

benevolence.oewn-01229168-n.tone: The broadest praise here, naming the good will driving the act as much as the act, whether the kindness lands or is only meant.

thoughtfulness.oewn-04848589-n.label: positive

family.axis: considerate regard for others → an active willingness to give

thoughtfulness.oewn-04848589-n.tone: Warmer than *consideration* for the same regard for others, because it credits the attention actually paid, making the kindness feel noticed and particular.

thoughtfulness.oewn-01232282-n.label: positive

family.axis: a considerate gesture → an act of open-hearted good will

thoughtfulness.oewn-01232282-n.tone: Praises the noticing behind the deed, where *consideration* praises the regard the deed shows.

generosity.oewn-04838958-n.label: positive

family.axis: considerate regard for others → an active willingness to give

generosity.oewn-04838958-n.tone: The most concrete member: praise attached to what someone is willing to hand over, money or time alike, where *benevolence* stops at the inclination.

consideration.oewn-01232282-n.label: positive

family.axis: a considerate gesture → an act of open-hearted good will

consideration.oewn-01232282-n.tone: Credit for regard paid to someone else — the kindness lies in the care taken, not in warmth as such.

forgiveness.oewn-01229679-n.label: positive

family.axis: a considerate gesture → an act of open-hearted good will

forgiveness.oewn-01229679-n.tone: Warmer and more inward than *pardon* for the same excusing — a wrong let go rather than officially remitted.

favor.oewn-01229430-n.label: positive

family.axis: a considerate gesture → an act of open-hearted good will

favor.oewn-01229430-n.tone: The kindness comes as something granted graciously, which leaves the receiver holding an obligation *consideration* never creates.

endearment.oewn-01230294-n.label: positive

family.axis: a considerate gesture → an act of open-hearted good will

endearment.oewn-01230294-n.tone: The most openly tender of these, since the act is affection displayed rather than care measured out.

scheme.oewn-05913942-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare procedure for reaching an end → a plan whose intricacy is itself conspicuous

scheme.oewn-05913942-n.tone: The intricacy is what it adds - a plan worked out in enough system and detail that the design itself draws notice, where *system* names only the method for getting there.

play.oewn-00558625-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare procedure for reaching an end → a plan whose intricacy is itself conspicuous

play.oewn-00558625-n.tone: Purely technical - a single move settled in advance and belonging to the team's game, passing no verdict on whether the plan is any good.

system.oewn-05911466-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare procedure for reaching an end → a plan whose intricacy is itself conspicuous

system.oewn-05911466-n.tone: The flattest member, a procedure or process identified only by the objective it is meant to obtain, with none of *scheme*'s insistence on intricacy.

policy.oewn-05910115-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare procedure for reaching an end → a plan whose intricacy is itself conspicuous

policy.oewn-05910115-n.tone: Adoption is what it adds - the plan has been taken up and stands as the settled course of whoever holds it, one person as readily as a whole social group.

purpose.oewn-05991037-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

purpose.oewn-05991037-n.tone: The weightiest of the plain words for a wanted outcome: it frames that outcome as what gives the planned action its reason, where *aim* only gives it a direction.

intention.oewn-05991037-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

intention.oewn-05991037-n.tone: Puts the anticipated outcome in the mind of whoever is acting, so it holds whether or not anything is done about it, unlike *target* with its attainable thing to be hit.

design.oewn-05991037-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

design.oewn-05991037-n.tone: Makes the intended outcome sound worked out in advance, a shape already settled on rather than the bare wish *intention* names.

intent.oewn-05991037-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

intent.oewn-05991037-n.tone: Clipped and formal beside *intention*, stating the outcome as something fixed on rather than merely entertained.

aim.oewn-05991037-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

aim.oewn-05991037-n.tone: The lightest and most directional of these: it points at the outcome without the justifying weight *purpose* carries.

end.oewn-05989760-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

end.oewn-05989760-n.tone: Abstract and cool, naming the outcome as the terminus at which the behaviour stops, where *goal* names the same thing as something worked toward.

object.oewn-05990115-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

object.oewn-05990115-n.tone: Dry and formal, presenting the wanted outcome as a definite thing to be got and believed gettable, without *target*'s invitation to score a hit or a miss.

goal.oewn-05989760-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

goal.oewn-05989760-n.tone: The plainest everyday word for the achievement a plan runs to and stops at, warmer and less abstract than *end* for the same thing.

destination.oewn-05990653-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

destination.oewn-05990653-n.tone: Sets the outcome as the ultimate one, the point everything else is serving, and carries the figure of a journey's end that *object* does not.

target.oewn-05990115-n.label: neutral

family.axis: an outcome loosely held in mind → a fixed point aimed at that ends the effort

target.oewn-05990115-n.tone: The sharpest of these: it makes the attainable outcome a thing to be struck, so falling short of it registers as a miss.

inform.oewn-00834860-v.label: negative

family.axis: bare giving of evidence → taking on the role of informer

inform.oewn-00834860-v.tone: Casts the act as a role rather than an occasion — you are not someone who spoke but an informer, and the faint taint sits in that role where *tell* has none.

tell.oewn-00956454-v.label: neutral

family.axis: bare giving of evidence → taking on the role of informer

tell.oewn-00956454-v.tone: The plainest verb available for producing evidence, naming the act and implying nothing about the one who does it.

spite.oewn-07566132-n.label: negative

family.axis: wishing others evil → needing to watch them suffer

spite.oewn-07566132-n.tone: The meanest-sized version of the appetite - the need to see suffering treated as petty and personal, where *malice* is weighed as something graver.

spite.oewn-04849746-n.label: negative

family.axis: nastiness of temper → a quality that threatens evil

spite.oewn-04849746-n.tone: Malevolence run down to nastiness — it takes in the merely nasty as readily as the truly malicious, so it can bite without carrying the threat *malice* carries.

malice.oewn-07566132-n.label: negative

family.axis: wishing others evil → needing to watch them suffer

malice.oewn-07566132-n.tone: The heavy word for the same hunger *spite* names, condemning it as settled ill will rather than a small grudge.

malice.oewn-04849544-n.label: negative

family.axis: nastiness of temper → a quality that threatens evil

malice.oewn-04849544-n.tone: The heaviest word here: not an unpleasant streak but a quality that holds evil over someone.

malignity.oewn-07565835-n.label: negative

family.axis: wishing others evil → needing to watch them suffer

malignity.oewn-07565835-n.tone: Formal and grave, naming the wish for others' harm itself without the appetite to watch it land that *spite* and *malice* carry.

vindictiveness.oewn-07566357-n.label: negative

family.axis: wishing others evil → needing to watch them suffer

vindictiveness.oewn-07566357-n.tone: Fastens the ill will to a grievance - the harm wanted is repayment, which gives it a reason *malignity* does not need.

cruelty.oewn-04852706-n.label: negative

family.axis: nastiness of temper → a quality that threatens evil

cruelty.oewn-04852706-n.tone: Names the cruel disposition itself, but pitched at the tension and annoyance it inflicts rather than at any graver damage.

meanness.oewn-04852915-n.label: negative

family.axis: nastiness of temper → a quality that threatens evil

meanness.oewn-04852915-n.tone: Deliberateness is the whole of the charge — not a lapse or a bad mood but meanness meant, which is what condemns it.

effect.oewn-05926071-n.label: negative

family.axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

effect.oewn-05926071-n.tone: Faintly disparaging: the impression treated as manufactured, something staged to be taken a certain way rather than one that simply arose.

feeling.oewn-05925333-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

feeling.oewn-05925333-n.tone: The softest of these, holding the vague idea as sensation and claiming no grounds for it, where *belief* claims firmness.

opinion.oewn-05925333-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

opinion.oewn-05925333-n.tone: Dresses the same vague idea as a position one would state and stand behind, more assertive than *impression* though no better founded.

impression.oewn-05925333-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

impression.oewn-05925333-n.tone: The plainest word here, naming the idea as something received without judging how well it stands up.

belief.oewn-05925333-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

belief.oewn-05925333-n.tone: The firmest of these, treating the vague idea as accepted rather than merely entertained, so the confidence carries further than in *feeling*.

presence.oewn-05925768-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

presence.oewn-05925768-n.tone: Neutral and bodily, naming not a guess about how things are but the sense that something is there.

intuition.oewn-05927628-n.label: positive

family.axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

intuition.oewn-05927628-n.tone: Dignifies the guess, crediting it as a kind of knowing rather than a stab in the dark.

hunch.oewn-05927628-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a half-formed guess held lightly → an idea credited and firmly held

hunch.oewn-05927628-n.tone: Informal and unpretentious, owning the guess as a guess and claiming none of the insight *intuition* claims.

evil.oewn-00746935-n.label: negative

family.axis: a single act of disrespect → conduct condemned as morally evil

evil.oewn-00746935-n.tone: The flat, absolute name for conduct that offends morality, condemning without argument or degree.

evil.oewn-04859319-n.label: negative

family.axis: a drag that holds you back → wrongness of the moral kind

evil.oewn-04859319-n.tone: The absolute term of the family - it names moral wrongness itself, and covers the principle held as much as the practice done.

wickedness.oewn-00746935-n.label: negative

family.axis: a single act of disrespect → conduct condemned as morally evil

wickedness.oewn-00746935-n.tone: Condemns the same conduct with a moralizing relish, as though the wrong were knowingly savoured rather than merely done — fuller-blooded than the bare *evil*.

violation.oewn-00747530-n.label: negative

family.axis: a single act of disrespect → conduct condemned as morally evil

violation.oewn-00747530-n.tone: Frames the disrespect as a breach, something owed and transgressed, giving the act a hard formal weight that *irreverence* lacks.

irreverence.oewn-00747530-n.label: negative

family.axis: a single act of disrespect → conduct condemned as morally evil

irreverence.oewn-00747530-n.tone: The lightest blame here: an act that withholds due respect rather than one that breaks anything.

liability.oewn-05168909-n.label: negative

family.axis: a drag that holds you back → wrongness of the moral kind

liability.oewn-05168909-n.tone: Faults a thing for weighing on you and hampering you, a practical drag rather than the moral verdict *evil* passes.

resentment.oewn-07564444-n.label: negative

family.axis: the plain feeling of being set against someone → deep, bitter anger and ill will that will not stay a feeling

resentment.oewn-07564444-n.tone: Anger and ill will that have settled and deepened, held against someone rather than flaring at them.

bitterness.oewn-07564444-n.label: negative

family.axis: the plain feeling of being set against someone → deep, bitter anger and ill will that will not stay a feeling

bitterness.oewn-07564444-n.tone: Names the same deep anger and ill will as a souring the person carries, where *resentment* keeps it pointed at whoever earned it.

gall.oewn-07564444-n.label: negative

family.axis: the plain feeling of being set against someone → deep, bitter anger and ill will that will not stay a feeling

gall.oewn-07564444-n.tone: The rawest word for that deep anger and ill will, giving it the taste of bile that *bitterness* only implies.

animosity.oewn-07563566-n.label: negative

family.axis: the plain feeling of being set against someone → deep, bitter anger and ill will that will not stay a feeling

animosity.oewn-07563566-n.tone: Cooler and more measured than *gall*, yet the only one here whose ill will is already rousing itself into open hostility.

hostility.oewn-07563271-n.label: negative

family.axis: the plain feeling of being set against someone → deep, bitter anger and ill will that will not stay a feeling

hostility.oewn-07563271-n.tone: The plainest naming of the feeling — being set against someone, without the bitter taste or the nursed grievance the others carry.

civil.oewn-00645401-a.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of rudeness → the social forms actually observed

civil.oewn-00645401-a.tone: Approval at its floor: it grants only that the manner was not rude, the minimal end of what *polite* also lets stretch to a satisfactory observance.

polite.oewn-00645401-a.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of rudeness → the social forms actually observed

polite.oewn-00645401-a.tone: Credits the social usages as kept rather than merely the offence as avoided, though the consideration it reports stays sufficient and unremarkable rather than warm.

vanity.oewn-07524235-n.label: negative

family.axis: esteem one is genuinely owed → self-regard swollen past what is owed

vanity.oewn-07524235-n.tone: Deflating - names the same excess as *conceit* but treats it as a preening softness, something faintly ridiculous rather than offensive.

vanity.oewn-04894324-n.label: negative

family.axis: hollow self-admiration → a settled overvaluation of one's own worth

vanity.oewn-04894324-n.tone: The softer of the two: it convicts the self-regard of being empty, pride with nothing under it, where *conceit* convicts the judgement behind it.

conceit.oewn-07524235-n.label: negative

family.axis: esteem one is genuinely owed → self-regard swollen past what is owed

conceit.oewn-07524235-n.tone: Harder-edged than *vanity* - the excess sits as a fixed overestimate of oneself, the kind that invites resentment rather than amusement.

conceit.oewn-04894324-n.label: negative

family.axis: hollow self-admiration → a settled overvaluation of one's own worth

conceit.oewn-04894324-n.tone: The harder verdict, charging a fixed and inflated estimate of one's own merit rather than the hollow self-admiration *vanity* names.

dignity.oewn-04894076-n.label: positive

family.axis: esteem one is genuinely owed → self-regard swollen past what is owed

dignity.oewn-04894076-n.tone: Loftiest and steadiest here - not a feeling held about oneself but a worth that earns respect from outside, so it cannot be accused of excess the way *conceit* can.

creature.oewn-09996081-n.label: negative

family.axis: a person worked as someone else's instrument → a person owned outright

creature.oewn-09996081-n.tone: Damns the person themselves as something another has made and can direct at whatever unpleasant or dishonest work is wanted, where *tool* damns only their usefulness.

tool.oewn-09996081-n.label: negative

family.axis: a person worked as someone else's instrument → a person owned outright

tool.oewn-09996081-n.tone: The coldest of the three: the person is an implement taken up for the dirty or merely unpleasant jobs, valued for nothing but being handled.

puppet.oewn-09996081-n.label: negative

family.axis: a person worked as someone else's instrument → a person owned outright

puppet.oewn-09996081-n.tone: Contemptuous with a note of ridicule — the person moves and acts, but the strings and the dishonesty behind the act belong to whoever works them.

slave.oewn-10628841-n.label: negative

family.axis: a person worked as someone else's instrument → a person owned outright

slave.oewn-10628841-n.tone: Drops the metaphor that *puppet* and *tool* run on and states ownership flatly, which is what makes it the heaviest word here.

bondsman.oewn-09884297-n.label: negative

family.axis: a person worked as someone else's instrument → a person owned outright

bondsman.oewn-09884297-n.tone: Formal and legal in cast, naming the same owned condition as *slave* but of a man specifically, and at a cooler distance.

indifference.oewn-04680827-n.label: negative

family.axis: placid absence of worry → settled failure to care

indifference.oewn-04680827-n.tone: Leans on the not-caring half of the sense rather than the calm half, so the composure reads as something missing and carries a faint reproach that *unconcern* escapes.

indifference.oewn-04643967-n.label: negative

family.axis: inactivity plainly named → absence of caring held against a person

indifference.oewn-04643967-n.tone: Names the want of enthusiasm or interest as a settled disposition, stating it without the reproach *apathy* attaches to the same trait.

indifference.oewn-07498922-n.label: negative

family.axis: soft flagging of interest and energy → blank absence of feeling

indifference.oewn-07498922-n.tone: The measured word for the state - it reports only that no emotional reaction came, where *stolidity* reads the same blankness as a thickness in the person.

unconcern.oewn-04680827-n.label: neutral

family.axis: placid absence of worry → settled failure to care

unconcern.oewn-04680827-n.tone: Weights the calm, casual side instead — an untroubled evenness that may be only a seeming, and names the absent worry without *indifference*'s hint that nothing is felt at all.

apathy.oewn-04643967-n.label: negative

family.axis: inactivity plainly named → absence of caring held against a person

apathy.oewn-04643967-n.tone: The heaviest word here for the same trait: caring about nothing, weighed as a fault rather than merely reported.

apathy.oewn-07498762-n.label: negative

family.axis: soft flagging of interest and energy → blank absence of feeling

apathy.oewn-07498762-n.tone: The flat, general name for the condition, taking in both the missing emotion and the missing enthusiasm, and treating the whole absence as a deficiency.

numbness.oewn-04643967-n.label: negative

family.axis: inactivity plainly named → absence of caring held against a person

numbness.oewn-04643967-n.tone: Casts the missing interest as feeling gone dull rather than a stance taken, which blunts the blame *apathy* carries.

passiveness.oewn-04643754-n.label: negative

family.axis: inactivity plainly named → absence of caring held against a person

passiveness.oewn-04643754-n.tone: The flattest member: staying inactive and starting nothing, with no claim about what is or isn't felt underneath.

listlessness.oewn-04644238-n.label: negative

family.axis: inactivity plainly named → absence of caring held against a person

listlessness.oewn-04644238-n.tone: Traces the inactivity to lethargy and drained energy, so it reads as something suffered rather than a withholding.

listlessness.oewn-07499249-n.label: negative

family.axis: soft flagging of interest and energy → blank absence of feeling

listlessness.oewn-07499249-n.tone: Plain and unadorned: the flat want of interest and energy named outright, without *languor*'s softness or *lassitude*'s formality.

stolidity.oewn-07498922-n.label: negative

family.axis: soft flagging of interest and energy → blank absence of feeling

stolidity.oewn-07498922-n.tone: Heavier and less forgiving than *indifference*: the missing reaction is treated as dullness of feeling rather than as a stance.

languor.oewn-07499249-n.label: neutral

family.axis: soft flagging of interest and energy → blank absence of feeling

languor.oewn-07499249-n.tone: The softest word here - the same lack of interest and energy carried as a slow, heavy-lidded mood rather than as a fault.

lassitude.oewn-07499249-n.label: negative

family.axis: soft flagging of interest and energy → blank absence of feeling

lassitude.oewn-07499249-n.tone: Formal and weary-sounding - the flagging interest and energy are framed as something drained away, where *listlessness* simply reports them gone.

mark.oewn-00653662-v.label: positive

family.axis: a trait that merely tells one thing from another → a trait that sets a thing above the rest

mark.oewn-00653662-v.tone: Registers the trait as a sign the thing carries, crediting it lightly where *distinguish* lifts it.

mark.oewn-00923709-v.label: neutral

family.axis: putting a marker on a thing → setting a thing apart as worth notice

mark.oewn-00923709-v.tone: The plain designating verb, working by figure as readily as by an actual mark and passing no judgement on what it singles out.

mark.oewn-04701248-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

mark.oewn-04701248-n.tone: The flattest word here: it registers that damage happened and passes no verdict, where *scar* insists the damage lasted.

distinguish.oewn-00653662-v.label: positive

family.axis: a trait that merely tells one thing from another → a trait that sets a thing above the rest

distinguish.oewn-00653662-v.tone: The member that leans hardest on the very positive reading the sense allows — the trait does not merely identify the thing, it raises it above what stands beside it.

distinguish.oewn-00924409-v.label: positive

family.axis: putting a marker on a thing → setting a thing apart as worth notice

distinguish.oewn-00924409-v.tone: The only member that raises its object rather than merely labelling it, conferring either conspicuousness or the status of being worth remark, where *mark* just designates.

differentiate.oewn-00653662-v.label: neutral

family.axis: a trait that merely tells one thing from another → a trait that sets a thing above the rest

differentiate.oewn-00653662-v.tone: The dry one: the trait is what separates this thing from that one, with none of the credit *distinguish* carries.

characterize.oewn-02703792-v.label: neutral

family.axis: a trait that merely tells one thing from another → a trait that sets a thing above the rest

characterize.oewn-02703792-v.tone: Flatly descriptive — the trait simply belongs to the thing, and no verdict on its worth comes with it.

folly.oewn-00513854-n.label: negative

family.axis: senselessness treated indulgently → senselessness condemned as madness

folly.oewn-00513854-n.tone: Weighty and censorious - it treats the behaviour as a failure of judgement grave enough to be named, where *craziness* simply calls it mad.

folly.oewn-04898528-n.label: negative

family.axis: poor judgement → folly ludicrous enough to be laughed at

folly.oewn-04898528-n.tone: Weighty condemnation of the trait, treating stupid or rash action as a fault with consequences rather than a slip.

folly.oewn-01250622-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

folly.oewn-01250622-n.tone: Weightier than *foolishness* - the mistake is named as an act of unwisdom, and the word sounds like a verdict on it.

indulgence.oewn-00513854-n.label: negative

family.axis: senselessness treated indulgently → senselessness condemned as madness

indulgence.oewn-00513854-n.tone: The softest way of naming senseless behaviour here, framing it as something permitted or allowed oneself rather than something to be condemned.

lunacy.oewn-00513854-n.label: negative

family.axis: senselessness treated indulgently → senselessness condemned as madness

lunacy.oewn-00513854-n.tone: The hardest word in the set - it does not call the behaviour unwise but insane, and means the charge to land.

craziness.oewn-00513854-n.label: negative

family.axis: senselessness treated indulgently → senselessness condemned as madness

craziness.oewn-00513854-n.tone: Plain and unbuttoned beside the grander *lunacy*, making the same accusation of madness without the formality.

frivolity.oewn-00514412-n.label: negative

family.axis: senselessness treated indulgently → senselessness condemned as madness

frivolity.oewn-00514412-n.tone: Aimed at clowning and buffoonery - antic performance rather than the misjudgement *folly* names, so the disapproval comes with amusement in it.

foolishness.oewn-04898528-n.label: negative

family.axis: poor judgement → folly ludicrous enough to be laughed at

foolishness.oewn-04898528-n.tone: The plain name for the same trait of acting stupidly or rashly, blunt where *folly* is grave.

foolishness.oewn-01250622-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

foolishness.oewn-01250622-n.tone: The mildest of the stupid-mistake words, chiding where *stupidity* condemns.

absurdity.oewn-04898878-n.label: negative

family.axis: poor judgement → folly ludicrous enough to be laughed at

absurdity.oewn-04898878-n.tone: Folly pushed to the ludicrous, so it draws laughter on top of the blame that *foolishness* alone earns.

indiscretion.oewn-04898753-n.label: negative

family.axis: poor judgement → folly ludicrous enough to be laughed at

indiscretion.oewn-04898753-n.tone: Mildest here, faulting the judgement rather than the sense, and stopping well short of *folly*'s stupidity or rashness.

stupidity.oewn-01250622-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

stupidity.oewn-01250622-n.tone: Blunt: the mistake is named by the mental failing behind it, so the contempt lands on the doer rather than the act.

imbecility.oewn-01250622-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

imbecility.oewn-01250622-n.tone: The harshest here - a mistake treated as proof of an almost total want of mind.

spot.oewn-00073081-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

spot.oewn-00073081-n.tone: The discrediting act figured as a small mark - smaller, and easier to rub out, than *stain*.

error.oewn-00071785-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

error.oewn-00071785-n.tone: The flattest of these three - the action is simply recorded as wrong, with no reach toward blame.

confusion.oewn-00073293-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

confusion.oewn-00073293-n.tone: Names the mechanism - one thing taken for another - which lets the mistake sound explicable rather than culpable.

blunder.oewn-00075610-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

blunder.oewn-00075610-n.tone: Heavy and clumsy, a mistake big enough to leave the maker embarrassed by it.

stain.oewn-00073081-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

stain.oewn-00073081-n.tone: The discredit sticks - where *spot* can be wiped off, this one is taken to mark the doer.

slip.oewn-00074648-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

slip.oewn-00074648-n.tone: The smallest and most forgivable, an unmeant slight miss in speech or writing, a small mishap, a memory that skipped.

lapse.oewn-00075344-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

lapse.oewn-00075344-n.tone: Attention gave way for a moment - blameable, but only lightly, and without the clumsiness of *blunder*.

omission.oewn-00075444-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

omission.oewn-00075444-n.tone: The mistake lies in what went undone, and the neglect in it presses harder than the bare inattention of *oversight*.

distortion.oewn-00074533-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

distortion.oewn-00074533-n.tone: Named by its result - the facts come out bent - which makes it sound graver than a simple miss like *slip*.

oversight.oewn-00075344-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it
