oversight.oewn-00075344-n.tone: Something went unnoticed, and the word half-excuses the mistake in the act of naming it.

botch.oewn-00075610-n.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong action plainly registered → a mistake that discredits the person who made it

botch.oewn-00075610-n.tone: Informal and dismissive - the embarrassment is over a job made a mess of, not the single wrong step of *blunder*.

unable.oewn-01830798-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat want of force → want of force taken as failure

unable.oewn-01830798-s.tone: Names the missing power or forcefulness as a plain attribute, without the verdict *ineffectual* passes on it.

ineffectual.oewn-01830798-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat want of force → want of force taken as failure

ineffectual.oewn-01830798-s.tone: Turns the same want of power into a judgement — force was expected here and it is not there.

extraordinary.oewn-01538743-s.label: positive

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

extraordinary.oewn-01538743-s.tone: The one member whose excess can flatter, registering a degree far past what was expected as remarkable rather than as a fault.

sinful.oewn-01538743-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

sinful.oewn-01538743-s.tone: Sizes an excess by calling it a wrong, so the same far-more-than-expected that *extraordinary* admires becomes something to answer for.

extreme.oewn-01538953-s.label: neutral

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

extreme.oewn-01538953-s.tone: Names the utmost degree flatly, measuring how far a quantity, amount or degree sits from the norm without ruling on whether that is a fault.

far.oewn-01539576-s.label: neutral

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

far.oewn-01539576-s.tone: Purely positional: it sets an opinion or action out past the norm and leaves the verdict to whoever is looking, where *outrageous* is all verdict.

stark.oewn-01539678-s.label: neutral

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

stark.oewn-01539678-s.tone: Absolute rather than excessive, saying a thing is complete or extreme with nothing softening it, so its force is bleakness rather than blame.

unreasonable.oewn-01538069-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

unreasonable.oewn-01538069-s.tone: Convicts the overstepping of having no argument for itself, a heavier charge than the plain over-the-limit of *excessive*.

steep.oewn-01538377-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

steep.oewn-01538377-s.tone: Informal and dry, registering a large overshoot as a grumble rather than the protest that *outrageous* makes of the same gloss.

excessive.oewn-01538069-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

excessive.oewn-01538069-s.tone: The flat statement of the case, that the limit has been passed, without the indignation *unreasonable* adds to it.

inordinate.oewn-01538069-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

inordinate.oewn-01538069-s.tone: Formal and cool, sizing the overshoot rather than complaining about it as *unreasonable* does.

outrageous.oewn-01538377-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

outrageous.oewn-01538377-s.tone: The hottest word here: the excess is treated as an affront, and the word demands that someone object.

undue.oewn-01538069-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

undue.oewn-01538069-s.tone: Faults the excess for not being warranted rather than for its bulk, the quietest complaint among the words sharing its gloss.

radical.oewn-01539365-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

radical.oewn-01539365-s.tone: Marks opinions and actions as standing well past the norm by commitment rather than by accident of degree, and eyes that commitment with reserve.

ultra.oewn-01539365-s.label: negative

family.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

ultra.oewn-01539365-s.tone: Not just distance but too much distance - it drives an opinion or action past the limit its own position would have kept to, where *far* marks the same remove and leaves the verdict open.

gratify.oewn-01184590-v.label: positive

family.axis: brightening someone's mood → giving way to what they want

gratify.oewn-01184590-v.tone: The satisfaction is handed over outright and the pleasure of it is the whole point, where *indulge* reaches the same result by giving way.

indulge.oewn-01184590-v.label: negative

family.axis: brightening someone's mood → giving way to what they want

indulge.oewn-01184590-v.tone: Keeps the yielding in view, so the satisfaction reads as a resistance dropped rather than a gift made.

humour.oewn-00861268-v.label: neutral

family.axis: brightening someone's mood → giving way to what they want

humour.oewn-00861268-v.tone: British spelling; the target is the person's mood rather than their want, so it works on temper where *gratify* works on desire.

humor.oewn-00861268-v.label: neutral

family.axis: brightening someone's mood → giving way to what they want

humor.oewn-00861268-v.tone: American spelling of the same move, and it measures success by the mood produced, not by any demand met.

stranger.oewn-10680441-n.label: neutral

family.axis: unfamiliar presence → marked outsider

stranger.oewn-10680441-n.tone: Flat and unjudging - it records only that the person is not of this place, and leaves open that they might belong somewhere else just as ordinarily.

alien.oewn-10680441-n.label: negative

family.axis: unfamiliar presence → marked outsider

alien.oewn-10680441-n.tone: Hardens the same non-belonging into strangeness of kind - where *stranger* says merely unknown here, this makes the person incompatible with the surroundings.

suspect.oewn-00926844-v.label: negative

family.axis: loose supposition → belief firm enough to accuse

suspect.oewn-00926844-v.tone: Belief pointed at a person and against them — where *think* merely holds a view, this one holds someone guilty.

suspect.oewn-00689827-v.label: negative

family.axis: confidence merely lacking → active imputation of bad faith

suspect.oewn-00689827-v.tone: The most accusing of these: it does not just withhold faith but pins something on its object, where *distrust* only declines to trust.

think.oewn-00633399-v.label: neutral

family.axis: loose supposition → belief firm enough to accuse

think.oewn-00633399-v.tone: The plain, unmarked way to hold something to be so, without the hedge of *suppose* or the formality of *opine*.

suppose.oewn-00633399-v.label: neutral

family.axis: loose supposition → belief firm enough to accuse

suppose.oewn-00633399-v.tone: Holds the belief provisionally, as something granted rather than asserted outright the way *think* asserts it.

reckon.oewn-00633399-v.label: neutral

family.axis: loose supposition → belief firm enough to accuse

reckon.oewn-00633399-v.tone: Informal and flatly settled — states the expectation as arrived at, with none of the tentativeness of *suppose*.

imagine.oewn-00633399-v.label: neutral

family.axis: loose supposition → belief firm enough to accuse

imagine.oewn-00633399-v.tone: Reaches the belief by picturing how things must be, so it sounds more speculative than *think* even when it means the same.

guess.oewn-00633399-v.label: neutral

family.axis: loose supposition → belief firm enough to accuse

guess.oewn-00633399-v.tone: The most offhand of these, conceding that the expectation rests on little where *reckon* sounds decided.

opine.oewn-00633399-v.label: neutral

family.axis: loose supposition → belief firm enough to accuse

opine.oewn-00633399-v.tone: Formal, and it frames the belief as an opinion delivered rather than a thought privately held as with *think*.

distrust.oewn-00689827-v.label: negative

family.axis: confidence merely lacking → active imputation of bad faith

distrust.oewn-00689827-v.tone: Flat and settled — the plain negative of trusting, delivered as a standing verdict rather than as the charge carried by *suspect*.

mistrust.oewn-00689827-v.label: negative

family.axis: confidence merely lacking → active imputation of bad faith

mistrust.oewn-00689827-v.tone: The wariest of the three, sounding like a misgiving felt about someone rather than a conclusion reached about them.

break.oewn-00935783-v.label: neutral

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

break.oewn-00935783-v.tone: Puts the hidden thing into public circulation all at once, with the abruptness of the arrival rather than any blame as its whole character.

discover.oewn-00935783-v.label: neutral

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

discover.oewn-00935783-v.tone: Here the act is the telling, not the finding: flat about how the thing got out and saying only that it is now public.

reveal.oewn-00935783-v.label: neutral

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

reveal.oewn-00935783-v.tone: The neutral centre the others specialise — something hidden is made visible, with no comment on who loses by it.

expose.oewn-00935783-v.label: negative

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

expose.oewn-00935783-v.tone: Strips the cover off with the implication that the thing was kept back for a reason, so the telling lands as a charge against whoever kept it.

disclose.oewn-00935783-v.label: neutral

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

disclose.oewn-00935783-v.tone: Formal and procedural: it makes the matter public without the flavour of trust broken that *divulge* carries.

divulge.oewn-00935783-v.label: negative

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

divulge.oewn-00935783-v.tone: Keeps the secrecy in view — what is told was meant to be kept, so the telling registers as a breach.

uncover.oewn-00935783-v.label: neutral

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

uncover.oewn-00935783-v.tone: Treats the matter as buried rather than merely untold, so the digging is part of the word in a way it is not in *reveal*.

talk.oewn-00939238-v.label: negative

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

talk.oewn-00939238-v.tone: The bare verb for someone entrusted failing to stay quiet; it names no content, only that the confidence got out of them.

blow.oewn-00936997-v.label: negative

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

blow.oewn-00936997-v.tone: The revealing wrecks what it reveals — where *disclose* only makes a thing known, this one endangers it in the same motion.

sing.oewn-00939238-v.label: negative

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

sing.oewn-00939238-v.tone: Contemptuous: the secret is handed over the way an informer hands it over, and the handing over is the disgrace.

spring.oewn-00937859-v.label: neutral

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

spring.oewn-00937859-v.tone: All timing and no secrecy — whether the thing is produced or disclosed, the force of the word is that it arrives with no warning.

leak.oewn-00939053-v.label: neutral

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

leak.oewn-00939053-v.tone: What the word specifies is the missing name — the telling happens with the teller kept out of sight, and it passes no verdict on what is told.

confide.oewn-00938497-v.label: positive

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

confide.oewn-00938497-v.tone: The one telling here that keeps the secret a secret: it goes to a single hearer in trust, where *divulge* gives it away.

blab.oewn-00939238-v.label: negative

family.axis: flat publication of what was hidden → a confidence spilled to the teller's discredit

blab.oewn-00939238-v.tone: Dismissive — the confidence falls out of an ungoverned mouth for no motive beyond the pleasure of talking.

story.oewn-06769768-n.label: negative

family.axis: a lie given a harmless name → a lie framed as something spun

story.oewn-06769768-n.tone: The plainest softening: it calls a lie by an innocent name, so the falsehood is admitted but treated as too small to bother about.

tale.oewn-06769768-n.label: negative

family.axis: a lie given a harmless name → a lie framed as something spun

tale.oewn-06769768-n.tone: Slightly more arch than *story* - the lie sounds spun and embellished rather than merely told, which makes it faintly amusing as well as false.

tall.oewn-00649139-s.label: negative

family.axis: long odds against believing → belief overwhelmed and struck dumb

tall.oewn-00649139-s.tone: Dismissive without heat - the claim is treated as stretched in the telling, where *improbable* only weighs the odds.

marvellous.oewn-00649139-s.label: neutral

family.axis: long odds against believing → belief overwhelmed and struck dumb

marvellous.oewn-00649139-s.tone: Refuses belief with wonder still in it: the thing is too wonderful to be admitted, not too flimsy, unlike *tall*.

improbable.oewn-00649139-s.label: neutral

family.axis: long odds against believing → belief overwhelmed and struck dumb

improbable.oewn-00649139-s.tone: The flat measuring word of the set - it sets the odds against the thing and leaves the mockery and the wonder to its neighbours.

incredible.oewn-00648515-a.label: neutral

family.axis: long odds against believing → belief overwhelmed and struck dumb

incredible.oewn-00648515-a.tone: Puts the thing wholly outside belief or understanding rather than at the far end of the odds, and says nothing about whether what exceeds them is splendid or appalling.

fabulous.oewn-00649004-s.label: positive

family.axis: long odds against believing → belief overwhelmed and struck dumb

fabulous.oewn-00649004-s.tone: Leaves the thing just this side of belief where *incredible* puts it past, and the strain it puts on belief sounds like extravagance rather than a fault.

astounding.oewn-00648878-s.label: positive

family.axis: long odds against believing → belief overwhelmed and struck dumb

astounding.oewn-00648878-s.tone: The heaviest impact here, and it lands on the person rather than rating the claim - covering both being thrown into confusion and being silenced by wonder.

partiality.oewn-06210871-n.label: negative

family.axis: a slight noticeable lean → a bias that shuts out fair judgement

partiality.oewn-06210871-n.tone: The plain name for an uneven leaning toward one side over the alternatives — it says the scales are tipped without saying the case is already closed, which is what *prejudice* adds.

prejudice.oewn-06211643-n.label: negative

family.axis: a slight noticeable lean → a bias that shuts out fair judgement

prejudice.oewn-06211643-n.tone: The heaviest word here, because the leaning has hardened into an obstruction: the issue can no longer get an objective hearing at all.

tilt.oewn-06212031-n.label: negative

family.axis: a slight noticeable lean → a bias that shuts out fair judgement

tilt.oewn-06212031-n.tone: Understates by design — a lean small enough to be measured rather than denounced, yet the word still insists it can be seen.

provincialism.oewn-06212164-n.label: negative

family.axis: a slight noticeable lean → a bias that shuts out fair judgement

provincialism.oewn-06212164-n.tone: Names the leaning by what it fastens on, one particular place, so the narrowness of the horizon is carried in the word rather than argued separately as it would be with *partiality*.

anger.oewn-00760325-n.label: negative

family.axis: a fault plainly named → a vice condemned as damning

anger.oewn-00760325-n.tone: The plain name for the belligerence, and the gloss lets the provoking wrong be merely supposed as readily as real, so the blame lands lighter than in *wrath*.

wrath.oewn-00760325-n.label: negative

family.axis: a fault plainly named → a vice condemned as damning

wrath.oewn-00760325-n.tone: The same belligerence at real or supposed wrong raised to solemn weight — a word sized for a sin, where *anger* is sized for a mood.

envy.oewn-00759688-n.label: negative

family.axis: a fault plainly named → a vice condemned as damning

envy.oewn-00759688-n.tone: Not simple wanting what another has: the gloss puts spite and resentment at the centre, so the ill-will toward the successful is the sense itself.

avarice.oewn-00759878-n.label: negative

family.axis: a fault plainly named → a vice condemned as damning

avarice.oewn-00759878-n.tone: Condemns while it defines — acquisitiveness called reprehensible and a wanting of wealth that nothing can fill.

rapacity.oewn-00759878-n.label: negative

family.axis: a fault plainly named → a vice condemned as damning

rapacity.oewn-00759878-n.tone: The same insatiable greed for wealth as *avarice*, but with a grasping, predatory force in the word rather than a hoarder's.

interference.oewn-01075919-n.label: negative

family.axis: slowing something down → stopping it outright

interference.oewn-01075919-n.tone: The broadest of the three, covering hindering, obstructing and impeding alike, and it frames the act as a course disrupted from outside rather than a way simply blocked.

bar.oewn-01079274-n.label: neutral

family.axis: slowing something down → stopping it outright

bar.oewn-01079274-n.tone: Flat and absolute: where *interference* only slows or hampers, this names prevention accomplished, with no hint of how it was done.

obstruction.oewn-01076422-n.label: negative

family.axis: slowing something down → stopping it outright

obstruction.oewn-01076422-n.tone: Puts something in the way, so the check is felt as a mass to be got around rather than *bar*'s clean stop.

colour.oewn-04685309-n.label: negative

family.axis: a surface that merely shades the truth → a covering got up to misrepresent it

colour.oewn-04685309-n.tone: British spelling of the same deceptive surface: a creditable tint lent to something so it passes, and no more than a tint, where *disguise* covers.

semblance.oewn-04685309-n.label: negative

family.axis: a surface that merely shades the truth → a covering got up to misrepresent it

semblance.oewn-04685309-n.tone: The barest word in the set, naming only the outward or token form and leaving the misleading to be inferred, where *pretence* puts the artifice on show.

color.oewn-04685309-n.label: negative

family.axis: a surface that merely shades the truth → a covering got up to misrepresent it

color.oewn-04685309-n.tone: A respectable-looking surface lent to something so it seems defensible; it does not hide the thing underneath, it only shades it.

gloss.oewn-04685309-n.label: negative

family.axis: a surface that merely shades the truth → a covering got up to misrepresent it

gloss.oewn-04685309-n.tone: Carries the idea of a polish worked onto the outside, so the deceit is one of finish rather than of concealment as in *disguise*.

disguise.oewn-04686431-n.label: negative

family.axis: a surface that merely shades the truth → a covering got up to misrepresent it

disguise.oewn-04686431-n.tone: The most covering word here, not a shading of the truth but an outward form that actively misrepresents what lies under it.

guise.oewn-04686265-n.label: negative

family.axis: a surface that merely shades the truth → a covering got up to misrepresent it

guise.oewn-04686265-n.tone: The same artful or simulated semblance as *pretence*, but framed as a form put on and worn, so the deceit sits in the assuming of it.

joy.oewn-05838106-n.label: positive

family.axis: a thing that merely stirs → a thing that is a source of deep happiness

joy.oewn-05838106-n.tone: The fullest of these — the person or thing is named for the depth of happiness it supplies, not for being merely agreeable like *pleasure*.

fillip.oewn-05837980-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a thing that merely stirs → a thing that is a source of deep happiness

fillip.oewn-05837980-n.tone: Brisk and slightly formal, it names a thing purely by its power to rouse, carrying none of the happiness built into *delight*.

defence.oewn-06753339-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a plea that concedes the fault it covers → a justification that clears the act outright

defence.oewn-06753339-n.tone: The plain word for the justification of an act or belief, passing no verdict on whether it succeeds and presuming no wrongdoing the way *excuse* does.

vindication.oewn-06753339-n.label: positive

family.axis: a plea that concedes the fault it covers → a justification that clears the act outright

vindication.oewn-06753339-n.tone: Carries the outcome inside it - the act or belief comes out justified, where *defence* only puts the case.

din.oewn-00608245-v.label: negative

family.axis: patient teaching by repetition → hammering a thing in until it sticks

din.oewn-00608245-v.tone: Blunt and wearing - the thing goes in by sheer relentless repetition, with none of the instruction *inculcate* implies.

inculcate.oewn-00607995-v.label: neutral

family.axis: patient teaching by repetition → hammering a thing in until it sticks

inculcate.oewn-00607995-v.tone: Formal and deliberate - repetition put to the work of teaching, and admonition counts as much as drilling.

mouth.oewn-06734698-n.label: negative

family.axis: a quick answer named neutrally → an answer marked as impudence

mouth.oewn-06734698-n.tone: Blunt reproof - the insolent answer reduced to sheer talk, named by the organ that produced it rather than by anything it said.

lip.oewn-06734698-n.label: negative

family.axis: a quick answer named neutrally → an answer marked as impudence

lip.oewn-06734698-n.tone: Informal and curt where *mouth* is broad, it clips the impudent answer down to a single flick of cheek.

sass.oewn-06734698-n.label: negative

family.axis: a quick answer named neutrally → an answer marked as impudence

sass.oewn-06734698-n.tone: Informal, and it hears spirit in the impudence that *lip* hears only offence in - still a rebuke, but an amused one.

return.oewn-07214582-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a quick answer named neutrally → an answer marked as impudence

return.oewn-07214582-n.tone: The plainest of these - it marks only that something came back quickly, leaving the wit or the criticism unremarked.

counter.oewn-07214582-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a quick answer named neutrally → an answer marked as impudence

counter.oewn-07214582-n.tone: Frames the quick reply as a move made against the first, so its wit or its criticism lands as opposition rather than mere answer.

rejoinder.oewn-07214582-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a quick answer named neutrally → an answer marked as impudence

rejoinder.oewn-07214582-n.tone: Formal and composed, dignifying the quick reply as a proper answer where *counter* casts it as a blow returned.

fail.oewn-01803246-v.label: negative

family.axis: hopes left unmet → trust broken and the person deserted

fail.oewn-01803246-v.tone: Puts the weight on not being there when relied on, covering both the proving undependable and the walking away, but stated as a lapse rather than a wrong.

disappoint.oewn-01802947-v.label: negative

family.axis: hopes left unmet → trust broken and the person deserted

disappoint.oewn-01802947-v.tone: The mildest of the three: hopes or expectations simply come up short, with none of *fail*'s claim that someone was depended on and abandoned.

tempt.oewn-00784574-v.label: negative

family.axis: an offer dangled → the trap sprung

tempt.oewn-00784574-v.tone: The lightest of the three: a promise held out to someone still standing free of it, where *lure* already has them moving.

entice.oewn-00784574-v.label: negative

family.axis: an offer dangled → the trap sprung

entice.oewn-00784574-v.tone: Works by making the promise attractive rather than by baiting a spot, so the persuasion sounds pleasant even when it is the exaggerated kind.

lure.oewn-00784574-v.label: negative

family.axis: an offer dangled → the trap sprung

lure.oewn-00784574-v.tone: Draws the person somewhere rather than merely dangling something, and of the three it keeps the falseness of the promise nearest the surface.

call.oewn-00785570-v.label: neutral

family.axis: an offer dangled → the trap sprung

call.oewn-00785570-v.tone: Neutral and technical here: the enticement is a mimicked animal cry, so the whole of the deception sits in the sound and none of it in any promise.

hook.oewn-00785089-v.label: negative

family.axis: an offer dangled → the trap sprung

hook.oewn-00785089-v.tone: The enticing is only half of it — the closing of the trap is the other half, which is what makes this land harder than *entice*.

steady.oewn-01997735-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

steady.oewn-01997735-s.tone: The evenest word here - determination as a level that never dips, without the hardness *firm* and *stiff* put into it.

firm.oewn-01997735-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

firm.oewn-01997735-s.tone: Resolution felt as something pressed against and not giving - resistance where *steady* offers only constancy.

stiff.oewn-01997735-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

stiff.oewn-01997735-s.tone: Unshakable, but by rigidity - the resolve reads as unbending as much as strong.

determined.oewn-01997455-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

determined.oewn-01997455-s.tone: Says the will outright and says there is a lot of it, with none of the hardness metaphor carried by *firm* or *stiff*.

desperate.oewn-01997589-s.label: negative

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

desperate.oewn-01997589-s.tone: Determination pushed to its extreme edge, where the resolve looks driven rather than chosen.

stout.oewn-01998668-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

stout.oewn-01998668-s.tone: Hearty approval - dependable in the way something sturdy is, solid enough to take weight.

bent.oewn-01997254-s.label: neutral

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

bent.oewn-01997254-s.tone: States only that the purpose is fixed and passes no verdict on it, where *steadfast* and *stalwart* praise.

stalwart.oewn-01998668-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

stalwart.oewn-01998668-s.tone: Dependability raised to staunchness - stronger praise than *stout*, and it suggests standing by as well as standing up.

undaunted.oewn-01998865-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

undaunted.oewn-01998865-s.tone: The purpose holds against something that might have cowed it - it implies the attempt was made and failed.

unshaken.oewn-01998865-s.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

unshaken.oewn-01998865-s.tone: The flat negative of the same idea - the purpose simply did not move, without the note of fear faced down in *undaunted*.

resolute.oewn-01996751-a.label: positive

family.axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

resolute.oewn-01996751-a.tone: Formal and settled, and it covers belief as well as purpose - firmness treated as a standing quality of the person, not a stand taken once.

insist.oewn-00779976-v.label: neutral

family.axis: earnest asking → pressing, self-lowering entreaty

insist.oewn-00779976-v.tone: Pressing rather than abject - the force sits in refusing to let the asking drop, where *implore* puts it in the emotion behind it.

importune.oewn-00779976-v.label: negative

family.axis: earnest asking → pressing, self-lowering entreaty

importune.oewn-00779976-v.tone: Formal, and the persistence lands as a burden on the person asked, where *insist* marks only the asker's refusal to stop.

pray.oewn-00761314-v.label: neutral

family.axis: earnest asking → pressing, self-lowering entreaty

pray.oewn-00761314-v.tone: The entreaty in its most formal dress, an appeal made in the posture of supplication rather than *beg*'s bare asking.

implore.oewn-00761314-v.label: neutral

family.axis: earnest asking → pressing, self-lowering entreaty

implore.oewn-00761314-v.tone: Raises the same entreaty to a pitch of desperation that *beg* states flatly.

crave.oewn-00760583-v.label: neutral

family.axis: earnest asking → pressing, self-lowering entreaty

crave.oewn-00760583-v.tone: Asking in a formal key, urged by earnestness rather than by *importune*'s wearing repetition.

supplicate.oewn-00760672-v.label: neutral

family.axis: earnest asking → pressing, self-lowering entreaty

supplicate.oewn-00760672-v.tone: The humility is the whole of it, stated outright and with ceremony, where *beg* leaves the asker's lowness implied.

imprudence.oewn-04901232-n.label: negative

family.axis: caution missing from practical dealings → a settled disposition to act headlong

imprudence.oewn-04901232-n.tone: Names the fault as an absence — caution simply not brought to practical affairs — and stops short of accusing anyone of charging ahead, which *rashness* does.

rashness.oewn-04901399-n.label: negative

family.axis: caution missing from practical dealings → a settled disposition to act headlong

rashness.oewn-04901399-n.tone: Heavier because it fixes the fault as a trait of the person rather than a gap in a decision: acting, and acting without prudence, not merely lacking it.

restlessness.oewn-14430687-n.label: negative

family.axis: ordinary annoyance → a visible flare of pique

restlessness.oewn-14430687-n.tone: The same shortage of patience heard as agitation that will not settle under delay, where *impatience* hears a demand that things move.

irritation.oewn-14429977-n.label: negative

family.axis: ordinary annoyance → a visible flare of pique

irritation.oewn-14429977-n.tone: The plain name for the state, carrying no verdict on whether it is deserved.

huff.oewn-14430474-n.label: negative

family.axis: ordinary annoyance → a visible flare of pique

huff.oewn-14430474-n.tone: Informal and faintly belittling — a state one is *in*, flared and conspicuous, next to the settled condition *vexation* describes.

annoyance.oewn-14429977-n.label: negative

family.axis: ordinary annoyance → a visible flare of pique

annoyance.oewn-14429977-n.tone: The lightest way to say it, the state at everyday strength without the weight *vexation* adds.

silence.oewn-04659534-n.label: neutral

family.axis: the plain habit of keeping things secret → the whole of it withheld, nothing said at all

silence.oewn-04659534-n.tone: Names the trait by its outward result — nothing said — where *secrecy* names the keeping back itself.

secrecy.oewn-04659534-n.label: neutral

family.axis: the plain habit of keeping things secret → the whole of it withheld, nothing said at all

secrecy.oewn-04659534-n.tone: The flat name for the trait, taking no view on whether what is kept back ought to be.

mum.oewn-04659702-n.label: neutral

family.axis: the plain habit of keeping things secret → the whole of it withheld, nothing said at all

mum.oewn-04659702-n.tone: Informal and clipped where *secrecy* is abstract, shrinking the same trait to one syllable of keeping quiet.

propriety.oewn-04905614-n.label: positive

family.axis: correctness of manner → conduct measured against moral standards

propriety.oewn-04905614-n.tone: The plain name for the standard — approving only in that it marks behavior as correct or appropriate, without the warmth *grace* adds.

grace.oewn-04907534-n.label: positive

family.axis: correctness of manner → conduct measured against moral standards

grace.oewn-04907534-n.tone: Turns propriety outward, joining the sense of what is fitting to consideration for other people, where *decorum* asks only that the form be kept.

grace.oewn-04647713-n.label: positive

family.axis: even-tempered endurance of delay or incompetence → a standing disposition of kindness and compassion

grace.oewn-04647713-n.tone: The warmest of the three and the widest: not endurance of an annoyance but a whole bent toward kindness and compassion.

reserve.oewn-04907298-n.label: neutral

family.axis: correctness of manner → conduct measured against moral standards

reserve.oewn-04907298-n.tone: Names correctness of manner as formality, so the coolness and the holding back are part of what is described rather than praise of it.

decorum.oewn-04905981-n.label: positive

family.axis: correctness of manner → conduct measured against moral standards

decorum.oewn-04905981-n.tone: Locates propriety in the visible layer — manners and conduct — commending the observance of form rather than any feeling behind it.

modesty.oewn-04907298-n.label: positive

family.axis: correctness of manner → conduct measured against moral standards

modesty.oewn-04907298-n.tone: The same formality and propriety of manner as *reserve*, but carried as an unassuming bearing rather than as distance.

decency.oewn-04907916-n.label: positive

family.axis: correctness of manner → conduct measured against moral standards

decency.oewn-04907916-n.tone: The strongest of these because it answers to morality as well as propriety, making it a floor one can be accused of falling below.

merit.oewn-05146223-n.label: positive

family.axis: a shortfall counted against a thing → a high quality counted admiringly in its favour

merit.oewn-05146223-n.tone: The same admirable attribute framed as something to a thing's credit, weighable point by point against *fault*.

value.oewn-05145753-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a shortfall counted against a thing → a high quality counted admiringly in its favour

value.oewn-05145753-n.tone: Unsigned by design: it takes the quality positive or negative alike, so it appraises where *virtue* and *fault* have already decided.

price.oewn-05148930-n.label: positive

family.axis: a shortfall counted against a thing → a high quality counted admiringly in its favour

price.oewn-05148930-n.tone: Puts the height into the word itself - not worth but worth pitched high, where *worth* names the quality without ranking it.

worth.oewn-05145473-n.label: positive

family.axis: a shortfall counted against a thing → a high quality counted admiringly in its favour

worth.oewn-05145473-n.tone: Plainly positive and broad, covering what makes a thing desirable, valuable or merely useful, with none of *price*'s insistence that the quality is great.

deep.oewn-01879131-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet intellectual depth → penetrating depth of mind or feeling

deep.oewn-01879131-s.tone: Plain, unshowy praise that locates the depth in the thinking itself rather than in the person's habit of it, as *thoughtful* does.

profound.oewn-01878713-a.label: positive

family.axis: quiet intellectual depth → penetrating depth of mind or feeling

profound.oewn-01878713-a.tone: The strongest of these and the widest, crediting either a mind that cuts through or a feeling that runs deep, where *deep* and *thoughtful* stay with the intellect.

thoughtful.oewn-01879263-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet intellectual depth → penetrating depth of mind or feeling

thoughtful.oewn-01879263-s.tone: Mild, steady approval for possessing intellectual depth, without the reach *profound* claims.

blaze.oewn-00923996-v.label: neutral

family.axis: putting a marker on a thing → setting a thing apart as worth notice

blaze.oewn-00923996-v.tone: Literal where *mark* is figurative: the sign is cut into trees, so the word carries its instrument and nothing evaluative.

buoy.oewn-00924742-v.label: neutral

family.axis: putting a marker on a thing → setting a thing apart as worth notice

buoy.oewn-00924742-v.tone: The whole force of the word sits in the marker it names, so it points a thing out without commenting on it.

dimension.oewn-00924113-v.label: neutral

family.axis: putting a marker on a thing → setting a thing apart as worth notice

dimension.oewn-00924113-v.tone: Technical and flatly informative — what it puts on a thing is measurements, with none of the singling-out for notice that *distinguish* carries.

defect.oewn-05170169-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

defect.oewn-05170169-n.tone: Puts the failing inside the thing as something missing or broken, a harder reading of the same deficiency than *shortcoming* gives.

defect.oewn-04699505-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

defect.oewn-04699505-n.tone: Names the spoiling mark as a fault, so the thing carrying it is judged wanting rather than merely marked.

shortcoming.oewn-05170169-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

shortcoming.oewn-05170169-n.tone: Takes the same failing as falling short of a mark, which leaves the thing whole in a way *defect* does not.

disadvantage.oewn-05169087-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

disadvantage.oewn-05169087-n.tone: The plain, unheated name for standing lower or less favourably, stating the position without accusing the thing that holds it.

awkwardness.oewn-05170334-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

awkwardness.oewn-05170334-n.tone: Locates the trouble in the embarrassment of a situation, so the discomfort is felt rather than the ranked shortfall of *inferiority*.

inferiority.oewn-05172702-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

inferiority.oewn-05172702-n.tone: Sets the thing below its rivals as a matter of competition, judging where *disadvantage* only reports an unfavourable position.

limitation.oewn-05169982-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

limitation.oewn-05169982-n.tone: Marks a boundary — limited or restricted — with no failing charged to anyone, which keeps it flatter than *defect*.

drawback.oewn-05172048-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

drawback.oewn-05172048-n.tone: Weighs the thing as a hindrance, something in the way of getting on, rather than an emptiness in it as *defect* has.

penalty.oewn-05172372-n.label: negative

family.axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

penalty.oewn-05172372-n.tone: The heaviest here, since the disadvantage comes as painful consequence earned by an action or condition, not merely suffered.

blemish.oewn-04699505-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

blemish.oewn-04699505-n.tone: Keeps the damage at the level of appearance — the thing is spoiled to look at, where *defect* calls it faulty.

crack.oewn-04700444-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

crack.oewn-04700444-n.tone: Graver than *chip* or *scratch*, since the break runs through the thing and only the parts still holding together keep it whole.

chip.oewn-04700256-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

chip.oewn-04700256-n.tone: Something is gone rather than merely marked, and the word makes the loss sound abrupt.

wart.oewn-04703780-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

wart.oewn-04703780-n.tone: Clinical naming for a raised growth, but abnormality is built into it — not the plain report *mole* makes.

dent.oewn-04700732-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

dent.oewn-04700732-n.tone: The surface has given way under a blow without breaking, so nothing is lost and it stays milder than *chip*.

scrape.oewn-04701248-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

scrape.oewn-04701248-n.tone: Damage dragged across a surface — broader than *scratch* and still shallow.

mole.oewn-04701152-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

mole.oewn-04701152-n.tone: Purely descriptive: a pigmented spot carried from birth, with no suggestion of damage or fault.

scratch.oewn-04701248-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

scratch.oewn-04701248-n.tone: The slightest indication of damage in the set — thin and superficial where *scar* is permanent.

scar.oewn-04701248-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

scar.oewn-04701248-n.tone: The heaviest of the damage words: the harm is over but permanently recorded, where *scratch* passes.

ding.oewn-04700732-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

ding.oewn-04700732-n.tone: Informal and belittling — the same blow-struck impression as *dent*, named in a way that makes light of it.

burn.oewn-04701438-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

burn.oewn-04701438-n.tone: Names the place by the violence that made it, which gives it a weight *mark* has not.

birthmark.oewn-04699986-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

birthmark.oewn-04699986-n.tone: Traces the blemish to birth rather than to any injury, so nothing is blamed for it.

check.oewn-04700256-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

check.oewn-04700256-n.tone: The colourless name for the same loss *chip* reports, with none of the sound of breaking in it.

nick.oewn-04700732-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

nick.oewn-04700732-n.tone: Smallest of the impressions, and the word makes the blow sound trifling where *dent* concedes real force.

stigma.oewn-04703433-n.label: negative

family.axis: a mark merely registered on a surface → a flaw that spoils or condemns the thing it is on

stigma.oewn-04703433-n.tone: Clinical and grave: the lesion is not merely present but read as evidence, the skin testifying to a disease.

patience.oewn-04647895-n.label: positive

family.axis: even-tempered endurance of delay or incompetence → a standing disposition of kindness and compassion

patience.oewn-04647895-n.tone: Plain praise for a temper that absorbs delay or bungling without souring, the trait named as if it cost nothing.

forbearance.oewn-04647895-n.label: positive

family.axis: even-tempered endurance of delay or incompetence → a standing disposition of kindness and compassion

forbearance.oewn-04647895-n.tone: Formal, and it makes the same tolerance sound deliberately held back - a reaction withheld where *patience* is simply an even temper.

mistress.oewn-10343410-n.label: negative

family.axis: a woman placed beside a powerful man → a woman named as adulterous

mistress.oewn-10343410-n.tone: The censure is inside the definition rather than added by the speaker, since the word names the relationship as adulterous and ongoing; where *concubine* marks a living arrangement, this marks a breach.

concubine.oewn-09971872-n.label: negative

family.axis: a woman placed beside a powerful man → a woman named as adulterous

concubine.oewn-09971872-n.tone: A term of position rather than accusation: it fixes a woman by the household she shares and the standing of the man in it, saying nothing about marriage being broken.

fancy.oewn-05904666-n.label: negative

family.axis: a false belief dismissed as a light notion → a false idea condemned as hollow and unworkable

fancy.oewn-05904666-n.tone: The gentlest way to call a widely held belief false, treating the error as a passing notion rather than an indictment of anyone holding it.

fantasy.oewn-05904666-n.label: negative

family.axis: a false belief dismissed as a light notion → a false idea condemned as hollow and unworkable

fantasy.oewn-05904666-n.tone: Sharper than *fancy*: the false belief is cast as something wished into being, so holding it looks like self-indulgence rather than a slip.

bubble.oewn-05904986-n.label: negative

family.axis: a false belief dismissed as a light notion → a false idea condemned as hollow and unworkable

bubble.oewn-05904986-n.tone: Adds unworkability to falseness — the idea is not only illusory but could never be carried out, and the word keeps the burst inside it.

sister.oewn-10621666-n.label: positive

family.axis: membership not yet complete → belonging claimed as kinship or honour

sister.oewn-10621666-n.tone: Turns fellow membership of a sorority, a union or any other group into a family tie between women, warmer than the bare enrolment *member* records.

member.oewn-10326901-n.label: neutral

family.axis: membership not yet complete → belonging claimed as kinship or honour

member.oewn-10326901-n.tone: The flat term for one of the people a group is composed of, joining and taking part included but no warmth or rank added.

pledge.oewn-10460984-n.label: negative

family.axis: membership not yet complete → belonging claimed as kinship or honour

pledge.oewn-10460984-n.tone: Names a person by an admission still unfinished, accepted but held short of the settled standing *member* assumes.
